2026.TA15.2.s:
Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Statement of Investment Objectives and Principles requires regular assessment to ensure that Toronto Atmospheric Fund portfolio remains aligned with its investment objectives, risk tolerance, and long-term financial sustainability. The Investment Committee is responsible for overseeing this work, including conducting an annual review of the Statement of Investment Objectives and Principles for continued alignment, monitoring asset mix and performance relative to benchmarks, and reporting to the Board.

Additionally, Section 6.2 of the Statement of Investment Objectives and Principles states “a portfolio risk assessment should be undertaken at a minimum of every five years and reported to the Board.” A portfolio risk assessment has been completed, led by HUB International, Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s investment advisor, with support from Toronto Atmospheric Fund staff and in consultation with the Investment Committee.

This report provides an overview of conclusions of the portfolio risk assessment, with a particular focus on the asset mix. Ryan Kuruliak, Senior Vice President and Practice Leader, Investment Consulting at HUB International will present highlights of the assessment and be available to address questions during the meeting.

2026.TA15.8.t: Direct Investment Request: EV Charging Enablement Company (DI.2026.I)
2026.TA15.8.s: The Direct Investment Committee recommends the Board approve an investment of up to $400,000 in preferred shares of a Canadian Electric Vehicles charging enablement company as part of a $2,000,000 seed financing. The company’s Artificial Intelligence enabled power management systems supports Level 2 Electric Vehicles charging in capacity-constrained buildings and fleet applications, reducing the need for costly electrical upgrades. The investment aligns with Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s clean transportation, retrofit, and electrification priorities, supports a Toronto-based company with early Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area traction, and is projected to enable approximately 2.19 million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent in cumulative emissions reductions over 20 years.

2026.TA16.3.s:
Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s 2027 Operating Budget is presented for Board consideration and approval. Budgeted revenue is informed by the investment strategy and asset mix recommended by the Investment Committee which includes projected returns from marketable securities, expected returns from Toronto Atmospheric Fund's direct investment portfolio, projected returns on new investments, and committed external funding. Budgeted expenditures are aligned with the projected revenues, both proceeds and external funding, and are allocated to activities that advance Toronto Atmospheric Fund's mandate while adhering to the minimum grant and maximum administrative expense requirements and maintaining the nominal value of the Toronto, Ontario, and Canada endowments.

The 2027 Annual Plan, which will detail the objectives and activities for advancing climate solutions across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area (GTHA), will be developed within the approved budget framework and presented to the Board at its first meeting of 2027.

1. Approve the 2027 Consolidated Operating Budget as presented in Attachment 1.
